build_optical_flow_model: build a RAFT optical flow model with configurable small or basic encoder and update block
create_feature_extraction: create feature maps from image pairs using the fnet encoder for correlation computation
test_forward_pass: test the RAFT forward pass to estimate optical flow between two image frames
review_upsample_flow: review the RAFT upsample_flow method that upsamples flow from H/8 to H using convex combination
summarize_initialize_flow: summarize the initialize_flow method that creates coordinate grids for optical flow initialization
